sections.Profile:
The "Sorcerer" pinball machine, released by Williams in 1985, is a fantasy-themed game designed by Mark Ritchie with striking artwork by Pam Erickson. Known for its captivating light show and multiball play, it features three flippers, three pop bumpers, two spinners, and a 3-bank drop target. The game's distinctive "Second Chance" post and the flashing eyes of the sorcerer on the back panel add to its unique appeal.
